title: Squash Fold
description: A flap is opened and flattened symmetrically.

steps.title: Make a triangle
steps.instruction: Fold the top-left corner to the bottom-right corner.
tips: Keep the colour on the inside.

steps.title: Fold in half
steps.instruction: Fold the triangle in half, point to point.
tips: The small triangle has a closed corner at the centre.
mistakes: Folding the wrong pair of points together.

steps.title: Open the paper
tips: You now have both diagonals as valleys.

steps.title: Turn over
tips: The next creases go in from this side.
mistakes: Skipping the turn, so the creases come out reversed.

steps.title: Book creases
steps.instruction: Crease both book folds, then unfold.
tips: Fold edge to edge each time.

steps.title: Turn back
tips: Diagonals are valleys, book folds mountains.
mistakes: Losing track of which side is which.

steps.title: Squash flat
steps.instruction: Open the flap and squash it into a square.
tips: Press the centre down so the sides spread evenly.
mistakes: An uneven squash that leaves a lopsided square.
steps.check: A small square with the closed corner on top.
